title: Measured VIF on catalogs simulated from the fitted ETAS lambda, where the true VIF is 1 by construction
ruling: HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.md §P7-8(b) ITEM (ii), SPECIFIED. Required before the S-15 floor may retire any catalog entry on floor grounds, before it may be quoted in any external artifact, and before Tranche B is priced.
priced_tests_note: Zero. No EXPLORE_COUNT.jsonl line is written. §P7-1(c) pricing-at-zero logic applies verbatim: this makes no rejection about the Earth and enters no BH vector. Every number here is computed on SIMULATED data with a known generating process; the object under test is the VIF ESTIMATOR, not a hypothesis about the world, so there is no multiplicity that could inflate any claim.

construction.why: counts[t] ~ Poisson(lambda[t]) independently across days, lambda = the engine's own fitted ETAS intensity summed over the domain. Conditional on lambda the variance equals the mean exactly, which is what the chi2 reference distribution in the VIF identity assumes.
construction.etas_simulation_path: DIRECT POISSON DRAW from the fitted lambda series. engine/baseline.py exposes no simulate/rvs entry point (EtasV1: fit / rate / mu / report only), so no engine sampler was bypassed. A self-exciting re-simulation of the triggering cascade was deliberately NOT used: it would reintroduce clustering and would no longer be a true-VIF=1 control.
construction.null: engine.mine.score_stat_block_bootstrap at the same block lengths, plus engine.mine.empirical_p for the circular-shift arm; combined by the miner's own rule (p_boot for periodic features, max(p_shift, p_boot) otherwise)

verdict: READING A STANDS. On true-VIF=1 data the estimator returns median 0.99 at block lengths >= 700 d, only 4% of the 24.08 measured on the Earth. The estimator is not manufacturing the inflation; the daily global M>=4.5 count series is overdispersed relative to the fitted ETAS lambda, the floor is real, and the programme is less powerful than it believed.
caveats: The control uses lag 0 only. The real per-feature medians for families 3 and 4 are taken over 31 lags; lag changes the design's phase, not its block length or its dispersion, so the comparison is made at matched block_days and the lag reduction is declared here rather than corrected for.

n_bootstrap draws per test is 2000 here against 50,000 in the real session. That sets the RESOLUTION of p_boot (and so of a single VIF value), not its expectation; the reported quantity is a median over 24 catalogs x features, and tests whose p_boot sat at the Monte Carlo floor are flagged per row (`p_at_boot_floor`).

The simulated target has the same MEAN function as the Earth's but not its clustering. That is the point of the control, and it is also its limit: it bounds how much VIF the ESTIMATOR manufactures, it does not estimate how much the Earth carries.
engine/out/cache is only ADDED to by this script (a prep npz and a dedicated 1-degree ETAS parameter file). Nothing there is deleted or overwritten.
